Record Class StaticCompilationConfiguration

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.micronaut.python.processing.staticcompile.StaticCompilationConfiguration
Record Components:
mode - The mode
reportDirectory - The directory the report is written to, or null for no report files
strict - Whether an explicit CompileStatic that cannot be honoured is an error
annotationNames - The qualified names of the decorators accepted as the switch
trace - Whether compiled bodies count their entries, see PythonStatic.entries()
public record StaticCompilationConfiguration(StaticCompilationMode mode, @Nullable Path reportDirectory, boolean strict, List<String> annotationNames, boolean trace) extends Record
The static compilation requested for a compilation: the mode, where the report goes, whether an explicit switch that cannot be honoured fails the build, and the decorator names accepted as the switch.
Since:
5.3.0
Author:
Graeme Rocher

    • isEnabledFor

      public boolean isEnabledFor(Collection<org.graalvm.polyglot.Source> sources)
      Whether the planner has anything to do for the given sources: the mode compiles by default, or a source applies one of the switch decorators, which can switch compilation on under StaticCompilationMode.OFF. Only the forms that switch count: a decorator (@CompileStatic, @module.CompileStatic, @Alias for a name imported as Alias) or the bare module-level statement; a mention in a comment, a string or an import alone does not start the planner. A compilation that compiles nothing does not pay for the planner, nor for the type checker it needs.
      Parameters:
      sources - The sources of the compilation
      Returns:
      Whether the planner runs
